note: The documents both halves of one measurement are driven over, so what tests/surface_census_test.py establishes about a selector's extension and what src/ir.rs's own test module establishes about which arm ran compose onto the same inputs. Each case names one selector, the src/ir.rs arm it was read off, the documents the selector must count (where the arm must run), the documents it must count zero (where the arm must not run, each naming the one part of the selector's condition it drops), and the permitted overlap another case of the same table also claims. Every document is this check's own input: it is not a corpus row and not a probe. A document is its `schemas` and `body` substituted into `envelope` at the two placeholder strings `{schemas}` and `{body}`, so the OpenAPI envelope the two halves drive is one piece of shared data rather than two copies.
